title: Families of smooth Fano fourfolds of Picard rank 1 without Bott vanishing
summary: We show that $χ(X,T_X) 1$ cases, we show that among all currently known smooth Fano fourfolds of Picard rank $1$, the only variety satisfying Bott vanishing is the projective space. By a result of Kawakami--Totaro, the existence of an endomorphism of degree greater than 1 implies Bott vanishing. Therefore, among the currently known smooth Fano fourfolds of Picard rank $1$, any variety admitting an endomorphism of degree greater than 1 must be $\mathbb P^4$.
